section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the main study (Study X): 212 female and 241 male university students in Timis County, Romania (total N = 453). Mean age was 23.57 years (SD = 7.86) and mean self-reported BMI was 22.18 (SD = 3.46). The sample were university students (72.2% undergraduate, 16.1% Masters, 11.7% other) and 97.3% self-reported Romanian ethnicity.
